Himachal Pradesh School Holidays Amid Heavy Rain Warning

Heavy rainfall has prompted the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) to issue an orange alert for Himachal Pradesh, leading to school closures and concerns about the impact on education. The district collectors have been empowered to suspend classes in case of severe weather conditions. As the state prepares for the worst, residents are bracing themselves for potential disruptions.
